description: World Rugby men's 15s world rankings (official rankings API, public, no key): position, team, country code, rating points and previous position and points, from the current table. Men's rankings only; the table is updated by World Rugby. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_fifa_team_rankings when you need FIFA men's national team world ranking: position, team; search_owgr_golf_rankings when you need Official World Golf Ranking: current men's position, player. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
